Attached: 1 image

Every node in a Kubernetes cluster carries the routing rules for every service. No central load balancer, no single point of failure, and forwarding capacity grows as the cluster grows. A skeptic's first contact with Kubernetes (2024) lands on kube-proxy as the mechanism: it watches every Service object and rewrites netfilter rules on every change. The tradeoff is real, since those rules live everywhere at once.

#kubernetes
